newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile's economy expands 5.7 pct in August.
newsitem.headline: Chile's economy expands 5.7 pct in August.

text.p: A monthly government index showed Chile's economy grew 5.7 percent in August from the same month last year, said the Central Bank.
The Imacec index data showed growth slowing slightly from July, when economic activity rose 5.8 percent.
The August figure brought average economic growth over the first eight months of the year to 7.4 percent.
The Imacec index is widely regarded as a rough guide to the expansion of Chile's gross domestic product.
